newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SANITAS POSTS 1.04 MLN LITAS MAY PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: SANITAS POSTS 1.04 MLN LITAS MAY PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's biggest pharmaceutical producer Sanitas said on Friday that its net profit in May rose to 1.04 million litas from to 780,000 litas in April.
The company reported earlier its net profit for the first four months of the year stood at 3.38 million litas.
Company director general Albertas Bertulis also told Reuters that the company's production output inched up to 4.3 million litas in May from 4.2 million in April.
"The production output for the first five months of the year rose to 20.28 million litas from 19.09 litas in the same period in 1996," Bertulis said.
Output in the first four months was 16.1 million litas.
Bertulis said the company's sales in the first five months of the year were 19.06 million litas, a slight increse from 18.08 million litas in the same period last year.
The company said last month that its sales in the first four months were 14.7 million litas.
The company exports 90 percent of its products, around 75 percent of it to Russia.
